args.body:
Summary of websites posted in #general:

1. www.informations.com (posted by Bob): An article about the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (posted by Eve): Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for its authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. The restaurant offers warm wooden interiors adorned with Swiss memorabilia, stunning panoramic views of the city skyline, and friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire — making every visit feel like a delightful journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site is clean and simple, which makes it easy to navigate. I appreciate that you included your contact information so visitors can easily reach you. If I may suggest an improvement: consider adding more content about yourself — such as your background, interests, projects, or skills — to give visitors a better sense of who you are. A bit more detail and maybe some visuals could really make your site more engaging. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — it's a wonderful hobby and a great theme for a personal blog! To make it even better, I'd suggest adding more content, such as posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. That would give your readers more to explore and keep them coming back. Looking forward to reading more about your hikes!
